usedFor: Buffer queues your social posts, and Gtwy’s AI agent hears about each “New Scheduled Post” via “Call AI Agent Instantly”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Scheduled Post” in Buffer, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: Each queued post reaches your Gtwy AI agent as a chat request, so it can review wording early.

watchOut: “New Scheduled Post” in Buffer is polling, so the AI agent hears about a post after the next scheduled check.
